description: Frame sync, venue gates, and joint target books for liquidity sourcing.

options.content:
**Sources:** `ControllerDiagnostics.frame`, `execution_gates`, `JointTargetBook`.

Frame sync readiness, liquidity-sourcing mode, per-venue live gates, and joint target books.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", flag AS metric,
  CASE WHEN (e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','sync_status', flag])::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES
    ('local_market_ready'),
    ('global_market_ready'),
    ('local_private_ready'),
    ('global_private_ready'),
    ('ledger_fresh')
) AS flags(flag)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> path, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> path, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES
    ('frame_age_ms', ARRAY['frame','frame_age_ms']),
    ('global_lag_ms', ARRAY['frame','global_lag_ms']),
    ('local_private_age_ms', ARRAY['frame','local_private_age_ms']),
    ('global_private_age_ms', ARRAY['frame','global_private_age_ms']),
    ('latency_skew_ms', ARRAY['frame','sync_status','latency_skew_ms'])
) AS ages(metric, path)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> path IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", gate.key AS metric,
  CASE WHEN (gate.value->>'live')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'venue_gates', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", gate.key AS metric,
  CASE WHEN (gate.value->>'has_orders')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'venue_gates', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT gate.key AS exchange,
  COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') AS role,
  COALESCE(gate.value->>'live', '') AS live,
  COALESCE(gate.value->>'has_orders', '') AS has_orders,
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)::text AS blocked_reasons
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'venue_gates', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local_orders' AS metric,
  jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND COALESCE(e.actor_id, e.payload->>'actor_id') = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts, 'global_orders',
  jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'global'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))::double precision
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND COALESCE(e.actor_id, e.payload->>'actor_id') = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", COALESCE(e.payload->>'mode', 'unknown') AS metric,
  CASE WHEN e.payload->>'mode' = 'liquidity_sourcing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND COALESCE(e.actor_id, e.payload->>'actor_id') = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  books.venue || '_' || COALESCE(books.ord->>'side', '') AS metric,
  SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(books.ord->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(books.ord->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 'local' AS venue, ord
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'global', ord
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'global'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord
) AS books(venue, ord)
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND COALESCE(e.actor_id, e.payload->>'actor_id') = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT actor_id
FROM (
  SELECT actor_id, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL
    AND actor_id <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  GROUP BY actor_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
  GROUP BY 1
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
